judge: claude-opus-5-5 (the main session; not blind: it had read both models' answers before scoring)
method: Ground truth written from 2 fps contact sheets of the exact recorded spans. Each clip has two key facts; each is scored 1 (stated), 0.5 (partly) or 0 (missed or contradicted).

vandalism.truth: A man throws a rock at a window and the glass cracks. The roughly 8 s source loop restarts inside longer clips, so the window looks intact again. In the 5 s clip the throw's follow-through and the cracked window are visible from 0 to 2.5 s.
facts: Throw at the window (or its follow-through)
Window cracks or is visibly broken

city_street_7_condensation_inside_housin.truth: Condensation inside the housing fogs the view for most of the clip. The view is sharp for about 1 s (6.5 to 7.5 s) when the loop restarts, then fogs again. A red SUV is at the right of the intersection.
facts: View is degraded or obscured (fog, haze, condensation, smear)
The view clears briefly or changes

highway_traffic_overcast_weather.truth: A highway in thick fog with very low visibility and a wet surface. A dark pickup with headlights approaches in the left lanes; a white van drives away on the far side.
facts: The vehicles and their movement described correctly

traffic_flows_in_the_open_lanes.truth: Roadworks (mini excavator, workers in hi-vis, barriers, cones) close the bus lane; traffic flows in the open lanes.
facts: Roadworks closing a lane (the bus lane)
Traffic flowing in the open lanes

busy_street.truth: A very dense crowd at night in a square lined with illuminated historic buildings; the camera is handheld and moves slightly.
facts: Illuminated city setting, no invented incident
